title: The Dinosaurs' Secret Password
subtitle: Say it when you want to join in
style: flat hand-drawn illustration on speckled cream paper with tiny grey flecks, the speckled paper fills the whole square picture edge to edge with no border, simple flat colour shapes with thin wobbly outlines, muted faded colours: rusty red, soft pink, pale yellow, soft green and grey-blue, ordinary objects drawn plain, without eyes or faces, the upper third of the picture left as empty speckled paper, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道吗？
恐龙玩游戏的时候，
有一句暗号。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus huddled close together in a circle on a grassy hill, whispering
pages.en:
Hey, kid.
Did you know?
When dinosaurs play a game,
they have a secret password.

pages.zh:
不知道暗号的，
谁也进不去。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus standing in a closed circle with their backs turned outwards, and one tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face outside the circle peeking in
pages.en:
If you don't know the password,
you can't get in.

pages.zh:
今天，我偷偷告诉你。
你凑近一点。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face leaning its big head in close towards the viewer as if to whisper, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Today, I'll tell you the secret.
Come a little closer.

pages.zh:
再近一点。
……好，太近了。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face leaning its big head so far forward that it tips over and lands flat on its nose, its tiny arms waving, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Closer.
…Okay, that's too close.

pages.zh: 不过，你得先听我讲完。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting down on a grassy hill like a storyteller, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: But first, you have to hear the whole story.

pages.zh:
恐龙最爱玩的游戏，
叫「滚大蛋」。
pages.scene: One huge round grey stone egg sitting on top of a grassy hill, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
The dinosaurs' favorite game
is called Roll the Big Egg.

pages.zh: 一颗比房子还大的石头蛋。
pages.scene: A giant round grey stone egg standing next to a small cottage, much taller than the cottage, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en: A stone egg bigger than a house.

pages.zh:
从山坡上滚下来，
大家一起追。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus chasing a giant round grey stone egg rolling down a grassy hill
pages.en:
It rolls down the hill,
and everybody chases it.

pages.zh: 三角龙管推。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face pushing a giant round grey stone egg with its horns
pages.en: Triceratops pushes.

pages.zh: 长脖子恐龙管在前面看路。
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing at the front of a grassy hill looking far ahead, a giant grey stone egg behind it
pages.en: The long-neck watches the path up ahead.

pages.zh:
最小的恐龙管喊「一、二、三」。
它只会数到二。
pages.scene: One tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing on a rock with its mouth wide open, shouting, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The littlest dinosaur shouts “One, two, three!”
But it can only count to two.

pages.zh:
所以每一次都是：
「一、二……二！」
pages.scene: One tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face shouting on a rock while one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face wait beside a giant grey stone egg looking confused
pages.en:
So every time, it's:
“One, two… TWO!”

pages.zh:
每只恐龙都有一件事做。
所以想加入，
光说「我要玩」不够。
pages.scene: Four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus gathered around a giant grey stone egg, each one busy with a different job
pages.en:
Every dinosaur has a job.
So if you want to join,
just saying “I want to play” isn't enough.

pages.zh:
暗号是两句话。
第一句：
「我可以一起玩吗？」
pages.scene: One tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face whispering into the ear of one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face
pages.en:
The password has two parts.
Part one:
“Can I play too?”

pages.zh:
第二句：
「我可以帮你们……」
后面，说你会做的事。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts pointing at his own chest while one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face listens
pages.en:
Part two:
“I can help by…”
and then say what you can do.

pages.zh:
不过，有一件事，
你一定、一定要记住：
千万别不说暗号，
就冲进去抢那颗蛋。
pages.scene: A giant round grey stone egg on a hilltop with four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus standing guard around it
pages.en:
But there is one thing
you must never, ever forget:
never skip the password
and run in and grab the egg.

pages.zh:
恐龙会以为你是来抢东西的。
呼——全跑光，
只剩一地脚印。
pages.scene: An empty grassy hillside covered with dinosaur footprints leading away into the bushes, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
The dinosaurs will think you've come to take their things.
WHOOSH—they all run away,
and all that's left is footprints.

pages.zh:
那天，你在山坡下面，
看见恐龙们在滚大蛋。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts at the bottom of a hill looking up at four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus gathered around a giant grey stone egg
pages.en:
One day, at the bottom of the hill,
you see the dinosaurs rolling the big egg.

pages.zh:
你太想玩了。
暗号？
忘了。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts running up a grassy hill as fast as he can, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
You want to play SO much.
The password?
Forgot it.

pages.zh:
你一下冲过去，
一把抱住那颗蛋。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts hugging a giant round grey stone egg with both arms, only one egg and no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
You run straight over
and grab the egg.

pages.zh:
呼——
恐龙全跑光了。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts still hugging a giant grey stone egg, and far behind him four dinosaur tails disappearing into the bushes with little clouds of dust
pages.en:
WHOOSH—
the dinosaurs all run away.

pages.zh:
地上只剩一圈脚印，
和你。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing alone next to a giant grey stone egg on a hilltop, dinosaur footprints all around, only one child and no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
All that's left is a ring of footprints…
and you.

pages.zh:
没人扶，
大石头蛋开始往下滚。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts reaching out as a giant round grey stone egg starts to roll away down a green grassy hill, only one egg and no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
With nobody holding it,
the big stone egg starts to roll.

pages.zh: 越滚越快！
pages.scene: A giant round grey stone egg rolling fast down a green grassy slope, no dinosaurs and no people in the picture
pages.en: Faster and faster!

pages.zh:
你一个人在后面追。
追不上！
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts running down a green grassy hill after a giant rolling grey stone egg, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
You chase it all by yourself.
You can't catch it!

pages.zh:
蛋滚过小河，滚过草地，
眼看就要滚进泥坑。
pages.scene: A giant round grey stone egg rolling towards a big brown mud puddle at the bottom of a meadow, no dinosaurs and no people in the picture
pages.en:
It rolls across the creek, across the meadow,
and it's about to roll right into the mud.

pages.zh:
你停下来。
你想起来了。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing still on a green grassy hillside, thinking hard, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
You stop.
You remember.

pages.zh:
你转身对着树丛，大声说：
「我可以一起玩吗？
我可以帮你们挡住蛋！」
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts facing a row of green bushes with both hands cupped around his mouth, calling out, no dinosaurs in sight
pages.en:
You turn to the bushes and shout,
“Can I play too?
I can help by stopping the egg!”

pages.zh:
树丛里，
探出一个个脑袋。
pages.scene: Four dinosaur heads popping up out of a row of bushes: a green T. rex head, an ochre triceratops head, a tiny yellow head and a long grey-blue neck with a tiny head
pages.en:
Out of the bushes,
one head after another pops up.

pages.zh:
恐龙们冲出来了！
三角龙推，长脖子看路，
你站在泥坑前面，
一伸手——挡住了！
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts stopping a giant grey stone egg at the edge of a mud puddle with both hands while one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and one very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face help
pages.en:
Out rush the dinosaurs!
Triceratops pushes, the long-neck watches the path,
and you stand in front of the mud,
hold out your hands—and STOP it!

pages.zh:
最小的恐龙站在石头上，
大声喊：
「一、二……三！」
它会数到三了。
pages.scene: One tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing proudly on a rock shouting, and one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face, one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts cheering around it
pages.en:
The littlest dinosaur stands on a rock
and shouts,
“One, two… THREE!”
Now it can count to three.

pages.zh:
现在你知道暗号了：
走过去，问一句，
再说你能帮什么。
要是他们说「等一下」，
那是游戏正玩到一半。
等一等，他们会叫你的。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts sitting on top of a giant grey stone egg together with four dinosaurs: a big green T. rex with tiny arms, a small round ochre triceratops, a very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur and a pink stegosaurus, everyone laughing
pages.en:
Now you know the password:
walk over, ask,
and say how you can help.
If they say “Wait a minute,”
the game is only halfway through.
Wait a little. They'll call you.
